osaka_wakitaya_nishitenma.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Horumon grilled in a house sauce, a horumon stew and a stamina rice bowl; yakiton and yakitori.
osaka_wakitaya_nishitenma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: offal, pork and chicken grilled over charcoal.
osaka_wakitaya_nishitenma.hours_raw: Mon–Sat, the day before and after a holiday 17:00–24:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed Sundays, holidays and the 2nd and 4th Mondays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats, mostly a counter; smoking allowed; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Opened 6 June 2017 (Tabelog). A stamina rice bowl at lunch in January 2022.
osaka_wakitaya_nishitenma.notes: [Izakaya · 西天満, charcoal-grilled horumon] A small counter izakaya between Kitashinchi and Nishitenma, open since 2017, where the owner grills horumon, yakiton and yakitori over charcoal and makes the sauces. Start with the wagyu horumon of small intestine and the beef tataki yukhoe, then work through heart, shiro-maru and tongue; small portions make it easy to eat alone. Prices are low for the area, around ¥3,000–4,000 a head. Busy with office workers after work; smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a hidden izakaya between Kitashinchi and Nishitenma where the chef grills offal, yakiton and yakitori over charcoal, with popular shochu; opened 6 June 2017. A March 2022 diner was told the sauces are homemade by the owner; a March 2023 diner describes the owner grilling.

anecdotes.text: "I heard they are homemade by the owner." — March 2022, of the sauces.
"Everything is reasonably priced and there are small portion sizes available, perfect for enjoying a meal alone." — March 2023.
"It's bustling with salarymen after work." — February 2025.

osaka_kayou_nishiumeda_dojima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Vegetable kaiseki with a house dressing, tempura, Omi fu, Omi chicken hotpot and Omi beef sukiyaki.
osaka_kayou_nishiumeda_dojima.vegan_detail: Ask. A vegetable-led restaurant with all-you-can-eat salad, and Tabelog ticks "vegetarian options", but the courses include chicken, pork and beef hotpots and nothing is described as vegan.
osaka_kayou_nishiumeda_dojima.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30; Sunday lunch by course only) and 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); open year-round (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; after 13:00 at lunch by phone only (September 2026). Starter ¥330, not with courses (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay (Tabelog). 40 seats; private rooms for 2 to over 30; non-smoking; Osaka gold sticker for infection control (Tabelog).
osaka_kayou_nishiumeda_dojima.notes: [Japanese · Dojima, Shiga's vegetables from the farm] A forty-seat Japanese restaurant in Dojima run by a Shiga company that grows its own vegetables in Moriyama and trucks in produce from local farms each day. The signature is an all-you-can-eat 'Omi vegetable' salad, served in a flowerpot and dressed from a watering can at the table. Dinner courses from ¥4,000 add an Omi chicken hotpot or Omi beef sukiyaki, red konnyaku, tempura and seasoned rice; the ¥1,210 lunch set comes with free refills of salad and rice. Open daily, non-smoking, with private rooms.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: an Omi-vegetable restaurant supplied direct from the company's own farm in Moriyama, Shiga, and more than 300 local farmers growing over 100 varieties; four trucks collect from producers each morning; Omi beef bought whole; Lake Biwa fish. The Tabelog invoice number T5160001016157 is registered to 株式会社ガーデン, 守山市 (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02).

anecdotes.text: "The highlight was when the staff poured the dressing over the salad using a watering can, just like watering flowers!" — August 2026.
"In addition to Omi vegetables, there were also dishes featuring red konnyaku and Omi fu, which made me feel connected to Shiga." — August 2026.
"The rice is a mix of home-grown brown rice and Omi rice. This is also available for unlimited servings, which is a wonderful service." — September 2026, lunch.

osaka_deiribashi_kintsubaya.gf_detail: Ask. No ingredient information. Kintsuba is usually a red-bean square in a thin batter; abekawa mochi is rice cake in soybean flour; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_deiribashi_kintsubaya.vegan_detail: Ask. Red-bean kintsuba, abekawa mochi and isobe-maki; no ingredient information.
osaka_deiribashi_kintsubaya.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 10:00–18:00; Sat 10:00–17:00; closed Sundays; hours may change (Tabelog). Items can sell out by evening (October 2026). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; October 2026). 18 table seats for eating in; non-smoking (Tabelog).
osaka_deiribashi_kintsubaya.notes: [Sweets · Dojima, freshly made kintsuba] A wagashi shop under the expressway west of Umeda, on Tabelog's sweets lists in 2022, 2023 and 2026, known for small kintsuba made fresh each day: a thin, chewy skin around gently sweet red beans that keep their shape. Buy a box of ten for about ¥1,000, or a single piece, and eat it the same day (warm it in a toaster if not); or sit in for abekawa mochi buried in soybean flour or zenzai. Cash only; other items can sell out by late afternoon. Closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog listing (not shop-maintained): Japanese traditional sweets and a sweets café; Tabelog Japanese sweets WEST 100 in 2023 and 2026, Sweets WEST 100 in 2022; 18 table seats; cash only.

anecdotes.text: "The kintsuba was unlike any pre-made ones; the skin was soft! It must have been freshly made, as it was slightly warm!" — October 2026, a box of 10 for JPY 1100.
"When I came to Osaka, I heard that I absolutely had to try the kintsuba here, so I made my way over!" — October 2026.
"There is also an eat-in option available inside the shop." — October 2026.

osaka_kushiage_chubo_kanta_dojima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kushiage and katsu in batter and crumbs; lunch is tonkatsu, hire-katsu, miso-katsu or kara-age set meals.
osaka_kushiage_chubo_kanta_dojima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, fish and egg skewers and katsu, with clam miso soup at lunch.
osaka_kushiage_chubo_kanta_dojima.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 (until sold out) and 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire for 8 or more (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog's original text says none ("なし"). Cards accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). 12 seats: a counter of 8 and a table of 4; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Opened 20 July 2003 (Tabelog).
osaka_kushiage_chubo_kanta_dojima.notes: [Kushiage · Dojima, light skewers and katsu lunches] A twelve-seat kushiage counter on a back street near Deiribashi, open since 2003, frying in all-vegetable oil to keep the skewers light. At night order the omakase skewers (five for ¥900 in 2025), with Kagoshima pork, whiting rolled in shiso and quail egg, without double-dipping. Lunch is katsu: tonkatsu or miso-katsu sets around ¥1,000 with rice, a good miso soup and a small dish, until sold out. Visitors to Osaka staying nearby come for a first taste of kushikatsu; smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: kushiage made light with 100% plant-based oil, Kagoshima "Chami Ton" pork, omakase skewers, courses and private hire, "our friendly owner will warmly welcome you"; opened 20 July 2003.

anecdotes.text: "During my visit to Osaka for sightseeing, I searched for a place near my hotel to enjoy some kushi-katsu." — June 2025, the five-skewer omakase.
"The round shape was surprising, and the fluffy texture of the fish was a revelation." — June 2025, of the whiting and shiso skewer.
"The tonkatsu was thinly cut with a light batter, so it didn't feel heavy at all." — February 2025, the hire-katsu lunch.

osaka_serena_hotel_nikko.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information on the buffet labels has been reported; carved roast beef, steak, sashimi and salads are where to start, while breads, pastries, pasta, gratins, ramen and desserts contain wheat.
osaka_serena_hotel_nikko.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegan options, but no review describes them; the buffets centre on meat, seafood and dairy.
osaka_serena_hotel_nikko.hours_raw: Daily 06:45–21:00 (last order 20:30); Saturdays and the day before holidays to 21:30 (last order 21:00). Breakfast 06:45–10:00; lunch buffet 11:30–14:30, 90 minutes; dinner buffet 17:30–20:30 on weekdays and from 17:00 at weekends and holidays, 120 minutes; à la carte 11:30–21:00 (Tabelog). A 15% service charge (Tabelog). Hokkaido Fair, 1 September–30 November 2026: weekday lunch ¥6,500, weekend and holiday lunch ¥6,800, weekday dinner ¥8,900 (Tabelog); soft drinks included at lunch, all-you-can-drink alcohol ¥3,300 (September 2026). Reservations (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD and QR (Tabelog). 101 seats and a terrace; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; hotel parking (Tabelog). Tabelog lists vegan and halal options; not described in reviews.
osaka_serena_hotel_nikko.notes: [Buffet · Shinsaibashi, Hotel Nikko Osaka's café over Midosuji] The all-day buffet café on the second floor of Hotel Nikko Osaka, right on Shinsaibashi Station, with windows over Midosuji. It runs themed fairs: until 30 November 2026 a Hokkaido Fair with jingisukan, soup curry, Hakodate shio ramen, scallop gratin from the chef's station and, at weekend lunch, build-your-own seafood bowls; winter brings crab. The carved roast beef and the desserts, especially the crème brûlée, are regular favourites, and breakfast has eggs cooked to order. Lunch is ¥6,500–¥6,800 plus 15% service. Families come back every year; one diner found dishes slow to be replenished and the mapo tofu not spicy. Open 6:45–21:00.

roles: Head chef of the café restaurant (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a café restaurant inside Hotel Nikko Osaka, directly connected to Shinsaibashi Station, serving hotel-quality buffet dishes day and night with chef-inspired creations; head chef Hideki Makihara.
chef_bio.specialty: Themed hotel buffets; carved roast beef.

anecdotes.text: "The luxurious seafood rice bowl, available only on weekends and public holidays, was a highlight, generously topped with salmon, squid, and turban shell" — September 2026, the Hokkaido Fair lunch, a fourth visit.
"However, I noticed that some dishes were not replenished frequently." — August 2026, lunch.
"I especially recommend the crème brûlée!" — August 2026, a family that has come since the children were small.

osaka_hariju_grill_dotonbori.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The steaks come with a demi-glace simmered for a week in beef-tendon broth (Tabelog), and demi-glace is usually made with flour; beef cutlet, fried shrimp, stew and hayashi rice contain wheat. Plain steak without sauce is the place to ask.
osaka_hariju_grill_dotonbori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yoshoku restaurant.
osaka_hariju_grill_dotonbori.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and dinner 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:00); closed Tuesdays, but open on Tuesdays that are holidays or the day before a holiday, and every day in December (Tabelog). Lunch A until 14:30, with a choice of corn potage or onion soup and rice or bread (October 2026). Reservations (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 58 seats; non-smoking; takeaway (Tabelog). Prices have risen, a September 2026 regular notes.
osaka_hariju_grill_dotonbori.notes: [Yoshoku · Dotonbori, the wagyu house's Showa-era grill] The Western-style dining room of Hariju, the 1919 kuroge-wagyu house at the Dotonbori entrance, next to its sukiyaki rooms and curry shop. It is old-school yoshoku made with heifer wagyu: a beef cutlet from tenderloin, hamburg steak, beef or tongue stew and hayashi rice, or lunch plates of thin steak and fried shrimp with onion soup. Diners in 2026 loved the beef cutlet, tongue stew and retro room; others found the steak thin, tough or lukewarm for the price, a beef stew that tasted thawed, or a staff member brusque. Closed Tuesdays (except holidays and December).

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a Western-style restaurant run by Hariju, the kuroge wagyu specialist in Dotonbori, established in 1919; it uses only female kuroge wagyu, and its traditional dishes have long been loved by all ages and nationalities. The group's sukiyaki house (osaka_harijyu_dotonbori) and curry shop (osaka_harijyu_curry_shop_dotonbori) are in data; a September 2026 diner also buys bento at the butcher counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Beef cutlet; heifer-wagyu steak with week-long demi-glace.

anecdotes.text: "The beef cutlet made from tenderloin was the best ever! So tender it melted in my mouth" — October 2026, the Special Lunch, a first visit in about 30 years.
"The plate, reminiscent of a classic Western-style restaurant, included fried shrimp, fresh vegetables, ham, potato salad, and beef sauté." — October 2026, Lunch A.
"The steak was tough for the price, and while it wasn't cold, it could have been hotter." — September 2026, the steak course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): はり重 グリル (ハリジュウ グリル)、洋食・ステーキ・ハンバーグ、道頓堀1-9-17、Namba 駅から徒歩3分、11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・17:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:00)、火曜休み (祝日・祝前日・12月は営業)、予約可、カード・PayPay可、電子マネー不可、58席、禁煙、テイクアウト、1919年創業の黒毛和牛専門店はり重が営む洋食店、黒毛和牛の雌牛だけを使う、牛すじのスープで1週間煮込んだデミグラスソースのステーキとローストビーフのコース (ストリップロイン11,000円、フィレ12,100円、両方13,200円)、ビーフカツ、ハンバーグ、ビーフシチュー。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): ランチA (牛ソテー、エビフライ、ハム、ポテトサラダ、オニオンスープかコーンポタージュ)、スペシャルランチ (ストリップロインのステーキとエビフライ)、ヒレのビーフカツ、タンシチュー、ハヤシライス、すき焼き御膳、Matsukado bento、レトロな店内、値上がり、ステーキが薄くて固い・ぬるい、ビーフシチューが解凍したような味、接客が物足りないという声も。

osaka_niku_bar_muu_higashishinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Teppan steaks by weight are the plainest; the garlic steak sauce, seared yukhoe and hamburg steak are not described.
osaka_niku_bar_muu_higashishinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a steak and meat bar; lunch sets come with oxtail soup.
osaka_niku_bar_muu_higashishinsaibashi.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 12:00–24:00: lunch to last order 16:00 (phone bookings only for lunch; lunch may be suspended on some days), dinner 16:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Mondays, with an occasional long weekend in 31-day months; two hours when busy (Tabelog). Lunch payment in cash or PayPay (December 2025). Reservations; the shop may phone to confirm (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR including Alipay; no e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats: a counter of 6 and six tables for four, with high chairs (Tabelog; November 2025); smoking allowed, so no one under 20 (Tabelog). Surprise steaks for birthdays (Tabelog).
osaka_niku_bar_muu_higashishinsaibashi.notes: [Steak · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a teppan meat bar under a red awning] A small grown-up meat bar on a Higashi-Shinsaibashi corner, hung with photos of the mountains the owner has climbed, grilling thick Angus outside skirt and wagyu by weight on the teppan, with seared wagyu yukhoe made in front of you and a good wine list. Lunch brings steak and tongue sets or an oxtail soup set for about ¥1,200 with five small sides. Regulars like the friendly owner and the secret dishes announced on social media; one found it cold in winter, another the high chairs wobbly after wine. Smoking allowed (adults only); closed Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a meat stand for adults in Higashi-Shinsaibashi; the interior shows photos of mountains the owner has climbed, and the owner welcomes talk about mountains and running. 2026 reviews describe a calm chef and an energetic owner, liked by local regulars.
chef_bio.philosophy: Delicious meat without worrying about smell or smoke (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan Angus outside skirt; seared wagyu yukhoe.

anecdotes.text: "The chef prepares dishes with a calm demeanor while the energetic owner runs around the restaurant, ensuring everything runs smoothly." — July 2026, starting with the seared yukhoe.
"The steak can be ordered by weight, making it a great option for those who want to enjoy a little bit of everything." — May 2026, after 22:00.
"The restaurant was a bit too cold, but I guess that's just how it is in Osaka during winter." — January 2026, a group of five.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 肉バル Muu、ステーキ・肉バル・鉄板焼き、東心斎橋1-13-23 日宝イルストリート 1F、Shinsaibashi 駅・Nagahoribashi 駅から徒歩3分、赤いテントが目印、火〜日 12:00〜24:00 (ランチは L.O.16:00、ディナー16:00〜24:00 L.O.23:00)、月曜休み、混雑時は2時間、カード・QR可、電子マネー不可、30席 (カウンター6、4名テーブル6)、喫煙可のため20歳未満は入店不可、記念日のサプライズステーキ、鉄板で焼く厚切りのアンガス牛ハラミと和牛ステーキ、目の前で炙る黒毛和牛のユッケ、肉に合うワイン、店主が登った山の写真。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年10月): 量り売りのステーキ (ヒレ、sirloin cap、ハラミ)、炙りユッケ、肉の食べ比べ、アンチョビポテサラ、ランチのハラミステーキ定食、牛タン、テールスープ定食1,200円、真空低温調理の黒毛和牛ハンバーグ、SNS の裏メニュー、店主が人気、店内が寒い、椅子が不安定という声も。

osaka_nikushou_gyuko_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Salted cuts and sashimi are the plainest; marinated cuts, ponzu, yukke sauce, the bread gozen and bibimbap are not described or contain wheat.
osaka_nikushou_gyuko_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a butcher-run yakiniku restaurant.
osaka_nikushou_gyuko_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); Sun 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations recommended; online bookings are confirmed by phone; same-day no-shows may be charged (Tabelog). Courses with two-hour all-you-can-drink ¥7,000, ¥8,000 and ¥10,500 (Tabelog). Lunch with free rice refills and coffee (August–September 2026); app members get free ice cream (August 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money; no service charge (Tabelog). 80 seats, private rooms for 2–6 and rooms for groups of 20 or more, some tatami; smoking allowed except at lunch; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog; September 2026). Down a flight of stairs (September 2026).
osaka_nikushou_gyuko_shinsaibashi.notes: [Yakiniku · Minami-Senba, butcher-run yakiniku with private rooms] A basement yakiniku in Minami-Senba run with a butcher shop, with private and tatami rooms and charcoal grills, one of a few Gyuko shops. Evenings bring courses with two hours of drinks from ¥7,000: tongue sashimi, meat sushi, thick tongue, three kinds of outside skirt. Lunch is the Instagram favourite: the 'Juni-hitoe' set of many small dishes around thick-cut tongue or wagyu top blade (¥2,530), with free rice refills and coffee. Diners in 2026 praise the meat for the price; one found a lunch slow (about 25 minutes), another a rice bowl less impressive than the photos. Smoking allowed at night.

roles: Staff (unnamed); meat from the group's butcher shop
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: safe, high-quality meat direct from its own butcher shop; fully private and semi-private rooms for groups up to 63. Gnavi lists other Gyuko shops in Nishinakajima, Sakaisuji Honmachi and Abiko.

anecdotes.text: "My favorite is the thinly sliced Top Blade with grated daikon and ponzu sauce." — September 2026, a second visit.
"At JPY 2,530, it offers great value!" — September 2026, the Juni-hitoe lunch.
"It took a little while to be served, about 25 minutes." — October 2026, the Juni-hitoe lunch with top blade.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 肉匠 牛虎 心斎橋店、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、南船場3-4-22、Shinsaibashi 駅から徒歩5分、Crysta Nagahori の北7出口から1分、旧 Tokyu Hands の裏、月〜土 11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:00)、日 11:30〜15:00・17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、不定休、予約推奨 (ネット予約は電話で確認)、2時間飲み放題つきの Saiga コース7,000円・8,000円・10,500円 (外ハラミ3種の食べ比べ、赤身の野菜巻き焼き、クラシタロース、特上バラ、希少部位)、カード・PayPay可、電子マネー不可、サービス料なし、80席、個室 (2〜6名)、20名以上の大部屋、ランチ以外は喫煙可、Wi-Fi、精肉店直送の安心で上質な肉。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 肉寿司、牛タン刺し、厚切りタン、サーロイン、ハネシタ、センマイ刺し、top blade のおろしポン酢、Juni-hitoe ランチ2,530円 (厚切りタンに Ranou の卵と出汁とろろ、黒毛和牛の top blade のユッケだれ)、希少部位5種のランチ、ハラミ丼、パン御膳、ご飯のおかわり、コーヒーつき、アプリでアイス、地下へ階段、提供に25分、写真ほどではないという声も。

osaka_yakiniku_lab_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an all-you-can-eat wagyu yakiniku restaurant.
osaka_yakiniku_lab_namba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00; last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private rooms for 2+ (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master) only; no e-money or QR payment (Tabelog). 43 seats, private rooms for 4 to 8; non-smoking (Tabelog). Ordering by QR code on your phone (May and August 2026). Tabelog gives the 2nd floor; a May 2026 reviewer took the lift to the 3rd. Some all-you-can-eat items sell out, such as heart sashimi on a Sunday lunch (May 2026).
osaka_yakiniku_lab_namba.notes: [Yakiniku · Namba, all-you-can-eat wagyu] An all-you-can-eat yakiniku a minute from Namba Station where even the entry course includes meat sushi, yukhoe and thick-cut tongue, ordered by QR code. Courses start at ¥5,500 with drinks; the top Kiwami course (about 130 items, steaks, uni and ikura) was ¥10,000 for the anniversary in 2026. Private rooms for dates; book ahead. Cards are VISA and Master only.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 1 May 2023 as the Namba shop of the popular 焼肉Lab in Umeda (sister shop linked on Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "About three minutes later, the staff came over and said, 'I'm sorry... it's sold out.' I had been looking forward to it the most" — May 2026, the heart sashimi at Sunday lunch.
"With the QR code ordering system, there's no need to worry about language barriers." — August 2026.
"Both lacked flavor and were overshadowed by the taste of the sauce" — April 2026, on the chicken and heart sashimi.

osaka_ujien_kissako_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog says allergy information is available; ask for it. The menu runs to parfaits with sponge cake, Mont Blancs, waffles and a matcha pasta at lunch, alongside teas and shaved ice.
osaka_ujien_kissako_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Teas (sencha, hojicha, matcha) are plant-only; the sweets use cream, ice cream and milk, and the shaved ice comes as "milk kintoki" (August 2026).
osaka_ujien_kissako_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Café (2nd floor) daily 11:00–19:45, last order 19:00; 1st-floor tea shop and Koden Yakuzen health-tea shop 10:30–21:00; open year-round (Tabelog). No reservations for café seats; bookings only for the afternoon tea set and the matcha experience (weekdays) (Tabelog). Waits of about 30 minutes at weekends (December 2025). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC and other e-money, PayPay and Alipay (Tabelog). 45 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; staff speak English, Chinese and Korean; menu with photos, on a tablet (Tabelog; December 2025). Children from primary school age order at least one item (Tabelog). Warm hojicha served instead of water (December 2025).
osaka_ujien_kissako_shinsaibashi.notes: [Japanese tea café · Shinsaibashi-suji, matcha sweets from an 1869 tea house] The second-floor café of Ujien, a tea merchant founded in 1869, right opposite Daimaru Shinsaibashi (take the lift at the back of the shop). Order a matcha or chestnut Mont Blanc or the hojicha parfait with a pot of sencha; warm hojicha comes free. No café bookings, so expect a wait at weekends; staff speak English, Chinese and Korean. Downstairs sells tea and takeaway matcha soft serve. Some reviewers find prices higher and sweets very sweet (2026).

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing and reviews: the café of Ujien, a Japanese tea shop founded in 1869 (Meiji 2) in Yamashiro, Kyoto (search results); interior art by Kosuke Watanuki (July 2025). A second café, 阪急三番街店, is in Umeda (search results).
chef_bio.specialty: Matcha and hojicha sweets; Mont Blanc.

anecdotes.text: "To my delight, instead of cold water, I was served warm hojicha in a pot. Truly a specialty tea shop!" — December 2025, after a 30-minute wait.
"Upon reviewing the menu, I felt that the prices have significantly increased compared to before." — September 2026.
"The texture was too grainy and the sweetness was overwhelming, making it hard to finish." — August 2026, a takeaway sweet.

osaka_logic_namba.notes: [Italian · Namba, Neapolitan pizza and cheap drinks] A two-floor pizzeria and Italian bar a minute from Namba Station, with stone-oven Neapolitan pizza supervised by a world-champion pizzaiolo. Order the Margherita or Quattro Formaggi, the assorted appetisers and the flowerpot tiramisu; downstairs happy hour (wine from ¥300) runs until 22:00 on weekdays. Courses with two hours of drinks start at ¥3,500. Open until 1:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): Neapolitan pizza supervised by Junichi Shoji, Pizza World Championship winner. anecdotes.text: "First, I was amazed by the great value of enjoying wine for just JPY 300!" — April 2026.
"I felt the pasta sauce was lacking a bit of flavor." — May 2026.
"The seating is limited to two hours, and after that, more customers started coming in, so making a reservation might be a good idea!" — August 2026.
